title: Parking Jam Hero
description: Unclog chaotic city parking lots by choosing the right exit order for gridlocked cars without scraping bumpers.
controls: Tap or swipe vehicles along their lane direction to drive them safely out of the crowded lot.

zh-CN.title: 挪车超人
zh-CN.description: 微信畅玩榜常驻爆款挪车解谜：面对纵横交错堵死出口的停车场，理清先后顺序依次把每辆小车丝滑开出马路。
zh-CN.controls: 点击或顺着车身方向滑动车辆，只要前方通道无遮挡即可顺利驶出停车场。
